title: Drift test relating skills/quest/SKILL.md to questSkillContent
description: ADR gap 3, at opum-doc main 2112fc6, docs/adr/distribute-lore-and-quest-agent-skills-through-the-plugin-marketplace.md (operator ruling 2026-09-25T14:09:02.971Z, dispatched by opum-agent as OPAG-421). The plugin-shipped skills/quest/SKILL.md is kept by hand and deliberately differs from the generated questSkillContent (agent-instructions.ts:244): it is a shorter pointer that says it installs from the plugin. No test relates the two; test/contract/bootstrap-process.test.ts only checks the generated .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md. Model it on lore-cli test/plugin-skill.test.ts. The copies need not be byte-identical, but the relationship must be asserted.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test fails when skills/quest/SKILL.md and questSkillContent diverge on anything the relationship is defined to share (at least the frontmatter name and description, and each command they point to)
The test is shown to go red on a deliberate drift in each asserted part and green on the clean tree
